description: NE Alabama regional artist, photographer, and content creator database. Source of truth for SL profile candidates, barter partners, and contributors.

artists.name: Michelle McGrady
artists.bio_short: Retired Anniston City Schools third-grade teacher turned full-time painter. Known for whimsical, colorful depictions of Anniston's historic downtown buildings.
where_to_find: Nunnally's Noble Frame & Gallery (Noble St, Anniston)
press: Anniston Star — 'Anniston teacher paints a new chapter with art'
artists.barter_pitch: SL profile + attribution in exchange for art usage on city/church pages
artists.notes: Featured at Anniston Downtown Market. Sells at Old Noble and Nunnally's. Contact via website.

artists.name: Joseph Giri
artists.location: Anniston, AL (16+ years in Calhoun County; born Mobile 1957)
artists.bio_short: BFA Auburn 1983. Known for Freedom Riders bus mural on Gurnee Ave and jazz mural near Anniston courthouse. 40+ years experience. Also worked in LA, Atlanta, Chattanooga, NASA JPL Pasadena.
public_art: Freedom Riders Greyhound bus mural — Gurnee Ave, Anniston (Civil Rights Heritage Trail / NPS)
Jazz mural — near courthouse, downtown Anniston
'A City Within A City' — Sacred Place (artist John Davis, Giri adjacent)
artists.barter_pitch: SL profile + attribution in exchange for art usage on city pages / civil rights content
artists.notes: Highly connected in NE AL arts community. 2024 NMR artist in residence.

artists.name: Jason Wright
artists.bio_short: Bass-baritone, theater director at Piedmont High School (Piedmont Centerstage Society), art instructor, worship arts director at AFUMC. Designed JSU opera posters 2007-2008. Has extensive visual art portfolio.
artists.barter_pitch: Already profiled. Follow-up: request poems + visual art portfolio for SL contributor role.
artists.notes: Interview recorded 2026-07-01 at Called Coffee. Video file at transcripts/jason-wright-interview-final.mp4 — needs YouTube upload. Has offered to send poems. Extensive visual art portfolio exists.

artists.name: Wayne Sides
artists.location: Anniston born; now Florence, AL (UNA Professor of Art)
artists.bio_short: Anniston-born photographer/artist. BA visual/performing arts UA; MFA photography Pratt Institute 1983. Known for KKK documentary photographs exhibited at Birmingham Civil Rights Institute. Professor of Art at UNA.
artists.barter_pitch: SL profile + attribution for use of architecture/documentary photos on city/history pages
artists.contact: University of North Alabama art dept
artists.notes: NE Alabama connection is strong (Anniston-born) but now based in Florence. Worth a profile as diaspora story.
